把 JS 用 `<script>...</script>` 包起來，放在客製 C: Wrap your JS in `<script>...</script>` and put it at the very end of Custom CSS. Do not write CSS after `</script>`; the first rule right after it will be dropped.
打字時只有 CSS 會即時生效，JS 要按「套用 JS」才會執行。按鈕有外框，代: While typing, only CSS updates live. JS runs when you click "Apply JS". An outline on the button means there are changes not applied yet.
切換主題或重新整理頁面時會自動執行。沒同意過的腳本會先跳確認框。: Scripts run automatically when you switch themes or reload the page. A script you have not approved asks for confirmation first.
寫成 `<script data-run-at=\"early\">`，同意過的: Write `<script data-run-at="early">` to run an approved script while the loading screen is still showing, for themes whose look depends on the script. A script you have not approved waits until loading finishes and then asks for confirmation.
寫成 `<script src=\"https://...\">` 可以從網址載: Write `<script src="https://...">` to load the script from a URL. Only https is accepted, and code inside the tag is ignored. If the file has a `<script>` block, only the JS inside it runs, so the same file can also be loaded as CSS with `@import`. Approval covers the fetched JS: when the JS changes you are asked again. "Apply JS" fetches the file again.
腳本可以寫 `export function cleanup()`，換腳本、換主: A script can `export function cleanup()`. It is called before the script is replaced or removed, or the theme changes.
用 `SillyTavern.getContext()` 存取酒館。要 impo: Use `SillyTavern.getContext()` to access SillyTavern. To import other modules, use full https URLs.
沒裝這個擴充的人匯入主題時，CSS 照常生效，JS 不會執行。: If someone imports the theme without this extension, the CSS still works and the JS does not run.
